title: 1.2 Security Laser Mirror
objective: Mirror the binary tree branches, then click the root node (50) to confirm laser alignment!
controls: Click [Mirror Tree] or root node -> Click root (50) to confirm
start_status: Step 1: Click [Mirror Tree [M]] or the root node to mirror branches.
hints: Mirroring swaps every node's left and right child. Use the Mirror button or click the root.
The root keeps its place after mirroring - click it to confirm the alignment.
